//epic-2-apps-web: RESOLVED by Epic 2. apps/web is a full member of `build` and `lint` again: the
`--filter=!papertree-web` that used to sit on both scripts is gone.
The two reasons it was there are both fixed:
next/core-web-vitals, which ships the PARSER but not the PLUGIN — so both rules had no
definition and 62 errors were 'Definition for rule was not found'. The plugin is now a
devDependency and the rules actually enforce something. 62 errors -> 0.
2. The two competing Highlight types are gone: types/highlight.ts was deleted along with
the legacy highlight stack, and one definition survives in types/index.ts.
Epic 2 left the v1 canvas surface type-broken and EXCLUDED in apps/web/tsconfig.json rather
than deleted (EPIC-02-RESULT.md §6.2). #75 moved it to archive/v1-web-canvas/ and removed all
three exclude entries; the 29 type errors they were covering — 25 in useCanvas.ts — went with
it, and apps/web now excludes nothing but node_modules. Epic 5 (#43) finds those components

scripts.py:lint: uv run ruff check packages services
